featured_reviews.name: amit ranjan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hello fellow learners...!!!

I would like to share my experience after completing the course and strongly recommend Edwin Art of Driving School for the following reasons

1. The training program is well-organized and pays attention to minute details of driving techniques.

2.Edwin classes and techniques are  significantly more effective than conventional motor driving schools, which often waste your time and money.

3.The course includes a theoretical framework explaining how a car responds in different situations before practical lessons begin.

4.Edwin team including his trainers are highly educated and skilled individuals who understand the emotional challenges faced by beginner drivers. They focus on addressing each learner's specific weaknesses and pain areas.

5. Edwin himself came to my first class upon my request despite his busy schedule, which demonstrated his commitment to the students.

6.From my first lesson on clutch control, I felt empowered and in command of the vehicle, significantly boosting my confidence.

7.The training also covers defensive driving techniques that are not commonly taught in India, helping me better understand other drivers' behaviors on the road.

8.The ability to schedule classes according to individual needs was an added benefit for me. I give this aspect a perfect score of 5/5 for their understanding and flexibility.

After completing the course, I have gained a level of confidence that I did not achieve through traditional motor driving classes. The premium fee charged is absolutely justified by the quality of training provided.

Thank you to Edwin and his team!
Wishing best of luck for his future endeavours.

I am writing to formally raise a complaint regarding my experience with your motor training school.

At the time of enrollment, I was initially quoted ₹7,500, which was later reduced to ₹6,500 after discussion and references. However, I later learned from another student that they were charged ₹6,000 for both 2-wheeler and 4-wheeler training along with license assistance. This inconsistency in pricing is concerning.

The training quality has also been unsatisfactory. The daily session was limited to 30 minutes with no flexibility or adjustment options. Additionally, the trainer appeared distracted during sessions and did not maintain a professional teaching environment.

I enrolled in July for a 20-day course, but due to my office schedule and lack of flexibility from your side, I had to discontinue after 13 days. When I requested to complete the remaining sessions later, I was informed that classes were unavailable due to a family emergency, and no alternative arrangement was provided.

Furthermore, when I requested either license processing or a refund for the incomplete training, there were repeated delays and unclear explanations. Later, I was asked to pay an additional ₹1,500, citing changes in RTO requirements. Even after agreeing to proceed, the process took around 1.5 months, and during my visit to the RTO, I was again asked to pay ₹2,000 by another representative, indicating a lack of coordination and transparency.

Given the above, I request the following:
1. A fair refund for the unused training days and additional amount
2. Proper scheduling of my remaining training sessions at my convenience, as originally expected

I request that this matter be resolved within 24 hours. If not, I will be compelled to escalate the issue through appropriate consumer grievance channels and share my experience publicly.

Experience : I was totally a nerd when it was my first day but as the day passes I understood the gear changing & the ABC (Acceleration, Brake & Clutch) of the cars. The other controls like side indicators and other usage were also taught side by side.
One thing that I dislike is that once I finished my first 12 to 15 days of training they started asking for "Gurudakshina" as a small prize to the trainer. Indirectly they just wanted some extra amount as a gift. Though I refused because I had already given a good amount to them as my fees.

SUMMARY : If you have any elder brother/sister or any relatives who drives well or can teach you well. GO FOR IT. There won't be any huge difference on how your knowns will teach you rather than those unknowns.

I am writing to formally raise a complaint regarding my experience with your motor training school.

At the time of enrollment, I was initially quoted ₹7,500, which was later reduced to ₹6,500 after discussion and references. However, I later learned from another student that they were charged ₹6,000 for both 2-wheeler and 4-wheeler training along with license assistance. This inconsistency in pricing is concerning.

The training quality has also been unsatisfactory. The daily session was limited to 30 minutes with no flexibility or adjustment options. Additionally, the trainer appeared distracted during sessions and did not maintain a professional teaching environment.

I enrolled in July for a 20-day course, but due to my office schedule and lack of flexibility from your side, I had to discontinue after 13 days. When I requested to complete the remaining sessions later, I was informed that classes were unavailable due to a family emergency, and no alternative arrangement was provided.

Furthermore, when I requested either license processing or a refund for the incomplete training, there were repeated delays and unclear explanations. Later, I was asked to pay an additional ₹1,500, citing changes in RTO requirements. Even after agreeing to proceed, the process took around 1.5 months, and during my visit to the RTO, I was again asked to pay ₹2,000 by another representative, indicating a lack of coordination and transparency.

Given the above, I request the following:
1. A fair refund for the unused training days and additional amount
2. Proper scheduling of my remaining training sessions at my convenience, as originally expected

I request that this matter be resolved within 24 hours. If not, I will be compelled to escalate the issue through appropriate consumer grievance channels and share my experience publicly.
